notes.title: Major update! Bug fixes and new content!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Thanks to everyone that has picked up Kivi on Steam so far. This game was designed exclusively for Steam so we really appreciate you guys and ladies joining in and feeding back your experiences on the game.
We have just launched a major bug fix and new content update. It addresses all of the issues users have been having and adds some new stuff too. Please see the list below for exact details.

- added some banging music.
- added a special aim for car and normal aim for character.
- added a tutorial about how to change weapons.
- added more balance.
- fixed reload bug.
- fixed katana DMG and added katana hit animation.
- made a fix for enemies sometimes now showing up.

You all rock,
Dan. ːSuperPugː
